Six days ago, Apple released iOS 27.2 developer beta 1, skipping over iOS 27.1 beta. With yesterday's release of developer beta 2, Apple has now launched the first iOS 27.2 public beta, which includes a brand new iPhone Health app. Apple has also enabled the ability to book and purchase lab tests through Quest Diagnostics.

iOS 27.2 beta includes an all-new Health app and more

iOS 27.2 will be the next release after iOS 27, which officially launched on September 14. iOS 27.1 is only available on iPhone Duo.

Apple detailed how the iOS 27.1 SDK lets developers take full advantage of the iPhone Duo's display capabilities. You can see what apps from different iOS versions look like on the iPhone Duo here.

Apple released Xcode 27.1 beta on Friday, adding iPhone Duo simulator support, as well as app development support for this all-new foldable iPhone.

The first iOS 27.2 developer beta includes the following changes:

  • The redesigned Apple Health app (first announced at the iPhone 18 Pro event) is now available in this beta.
  • Dual-lens shooting mode comes to group FaceTime.
  • Siri AI language support now includes French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish.
  • Apple TV app profile feature comes to iPhone.
  • Apple Podcasts' "Up Next" has been renamed to "Latest Episode". The "Continue Playing" section now sits directly below "Latest Episode". Podcast episode listings now also use a background color matching the cover art.
  • Apple Music now uses fewer icon colors to denote labels within the app.

iOS 27.2 is expected to officially launch in October. iPhone users who want to try the new Apple Health app early now have two options: the developer beta or the public beta.
